missed.fact: A second meaning is packed into appliesTo: an enum scope of ACTIVITY, TRACKER or BOTH. It is stored as a String and parsed with valueOf, so a renamed enum case breaks existing rows (see proguard-rules.pro:19). The pickers filter on it. A category can be scoped to activities only, but every UI-created category is BOTH.

Identity and deletion columns the map left out: updatedByDevice (the device that made the last edit) and deletedAtMillis (the tombstone). Reads use observeAll, which filters out tombstones. getAllRaw includes them.
On delete, the members are set to categoryId = null with fresh stamps so the change syncs. The category tombstone and the member clears are separate rows merged independently.

There is no name uniqueness, so a category is identified by its ULID id only. The Tracker creation sheet picks up a newly created category by name match (firstOrNull { it.name == n }), so a duplicate name can select the wrong category.

New categories get sortOrder = max live sortOrder + 1, computed from getAllRaw (filtered to live rows). Two devices creating categories at once can end up with the same sortOrder, because the order is not unique.
The pie chart groups by category and unit. Uncategorised sources of one unit share a wedge, and the uncategorised wedge has no colour.
